title: Ensure /etc/passwd permissions are configured correctly
description: Example control (not official CIS text). /etc/passwd should be world-readable but not group/world-writable.

title: Ensure separate partition exists for /tmp
description: Example control (not official CIS text). Confirming /tmp is a separate mount typically requires reviewing the deployment's partitioning scheme/fstab intent, which benefits from human review even when raw evidence is collected.

remediationMetadata.summary: Provision /tmp on its own partition/volume with nodev,nosuid,noexec mount options where operationally feasible.
